svg.title: Two physical degrees of freedom, counted honestly
svg.desc: Twelve initial-data functions lose four constraints and four gauge directions, leaving four phase-space functions. This is the local canonical count for ordinary four-dimensional GR, with first-class constraints. Four remaining phase-space functions describe two propagating configuration degrees of freedom.

g.text: 34 / TWO PHYSICAL DEGREES OF FREEDOM, COUNTED HONESTLY
Count initial data in phase space
Positions and their conjugate momenta are counted separately.
